questions.question: True or False: Juninho Paulista was named the Premier League Player of the Season in 1996–97 while playing for Middlesbrough, despite the club being relegated from the top flight in the same campaign.
questions.explanation: Juninho Paulista won the Premier League Player of the Season award for 1996–97 after inspiring Middlesbrough to both domestic cup finals, though a 3-point deduction ultimately saw Boro relegated in 19th place.

questions.question: Which striker joined Blackburn Rovers from Norwich City in July 1994 and scored 15 Premier League goals during their 1994–95 title-winning season?
questions.explanation: Chris Sutton formed the famous 'SAS' partnership in his debut season at Ewood Park, scoring 15 top-flight goals to help Blackburn Rovers secure the title.

questions.question: Which Spanish midfielder scored a famous lob from inside his own half for Liverpool in a 2–0 Premier League victory against Newcastle United at Anfield in September 2006?
questions.explanation: Xabi Alonso spotted Newcastle goalkeeper Steve Harper off his line and struck a shot from inside his own half on 20 September 2006 to complete a 2–0 win.

questions.question: Who was the first manager from outside the British Isles to win the Premier League title, leading Arsenal to victory in the 1997–98 season?
questions.explanation: French manager Arsène Wenger won the Premier League title in his first full season in charge of Arsenal (1997–98), becoming the first non-British or Irish manager to lift the trophy.

questions.question: Which Israeli playmaker scored two goals for Southampton during their famous 6–3 Premier League victory over Manchester United at The Dell in October 1996?
questions.explanation: Eyal Berkovic produced a masterclass at The Dell on 26 October 1996, scoring twice and providing two assists as Southampton defeated champions Manchester United 6–3.
questions.anchorClues: Eyal Berkovic / Southampton vs Man Utd 1996

questions.question: Which manager guided Reading to an 8th-place finish with 55 points in their inaugural Premier League campaign during the 2006–07 season?
questions.explanation: Steve Coppell led newly promoted Reading to 8th place in 2006–07, narrowly missing out on European qualification in the club's first-ever top-flight season.

questions.question: Which Nigerian forward scored a 15-minute second-half hat-trick for Arsenal to turn a 2–0 deficit into a 3–2 Premier League victory over Chelsea at Stamford Bridge in October 1999?
questions.explanation: Nwankwo Kanu struck in the 75th, 83rd, and 90th minutes—including a famous winner curled in from near the corner flag—to earn Arsenal a 3–2 win at Stamford Bridge.

questions.question: Which club finished as runners-up to Manchester United in the inaugural 1992–93 Premier League season?
questions.explanation: Aston Villa, managed by Ron Atkinson, finished 2nd in the inaugural 1992–93 Premier League season with 74 points, 10 points behind champions Manchester United.

questions.question: Which Australian striker scored all four goals for Leeds United in a memorable 4–3 Premier League victory over Liverpool at Elland Road in November 2000?
questions.explanation: Mark Viduka netted four times against Liverpool on 4 November 2000 at Elland Road, completing a legendary comeback from 2–0 down to win 4–3.
questions.anchorClues: Mark Viduka / Leeds United vs Liverpool 2000

questions.question: Which club secured the 1994–95 Premier League title on the final day of the season despite suffering a 2–1 defeat away at Liverpool?
questions.explanation: Blackburn Rovers lost 2–1 at Anfield on 14 May 1995, but won their first top-flight title in 81 years after 2nd-placed Manchester United could only draw 1–1 at West Ham United.
